Date: Sun, 1 Aug 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Quick recap + suggested next steps after demo

Hi Lena / Tom —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Short recap from our side and suggested next steps so we keep momentum: 

Recap (what we heard)
- Primary goal: reduce inference latency for your clinical triage model from ~450ms to <200ms for 99th percentile while lowering per-token cost.
- Migration source: currently running a self-managed GPU cluster (on-prem colocation) with a custom serving stack; interested in either Dedicated capacity (reserved Redwood pools) or Private VPC (customer-managed infra) due to PHI concerns.
- Constraints: SOC2 + encryption-at-rest, VPC peering requirement, and a 3-month pilot window with a clear rollback path.

Open questions we captured
- Do you need on-prem (air-gapped) or will a VPC-hosted Private deployment suffice?
- Expected QPS for pilot (avg vs burst)? You mentioned 20 qps avg, 80 qps burst — can you confirm?
- Anything else from procurement for contract/PO cadence?

Suggested next steps
1) Technical mapping call (30 min) — Camila to walk through VPC networking and onboarding checklist.
2) Security packet + preliminary SOC2 answers (attached).
3) Pilot proposal: 3-week Dedicated trial vs Private VPC test — we’ll prepare both scoping docs and a simple decision matrix.

Proposed timing: Technical call Tuesday 2027-08-03 10:00am PT (I’ll lock if this works).

I’ve attached a short Dedicated capacity outline and a draft migration milestones doc for reference. Camila / Karthik — please add any technical caveats I missed.

Thanks,
Jonas

Thanks Jonas — this is helpful. Quick answers inline: 

- On-prem vs VPC: For Phase 1 (pilot) a Private VPC in our AWS account is fine. We only require full on-prem (air-gapped) for regulated research datasets later in the year — can be Phase 2.
- QPS: Confirming pilot target ~25 qps sustained, 100 qps burst (30s windows) — latency SLO is critical.
- Procurement: We can raise an initial SOW/PO for a 3-week pilot; procurement team needs a redlineable SOW and a standard security questionnaire answered.

We like the two-path approach (Dedicated trial vs Private VPC). Can Camila share the VPC peering/networking checklist so infra can pre-approve? Also, please include KMS integration notes (we use AWS KMS).

Tom and I are available for Tue 10am PT.

-Lena

Subject: VPC checklist + quick technical notes for pilot

Hi Lena / team —

Quick VPC/networking checklist (high level) — I’ll send a full doc during the call but posting core items so infra can validate ahead of time:
- VPC peering or PrivateLink supported (we recommend PrivateLink for cross-account with minimal route table changes).
- Outbound egress to Redwood control-plane IPs over TLS (we’ll provide CIDR list).
- Subnet sizing: minimum 3 private subnets across AZs for HA.
- KMS: customer-managed CMKs are supported; we need an IAM role for key usage and an endpoint to call STS.
- Ports: 443 outbound for control plane, 50051 for gRPC if using internal load balancing.

Technical caveats for migration from self-hosted cluster:
- Model compatibility: we’ll validate model format/weights during intake — if you’re using a custom kernel we may need a short compatibility pass (2–3 days).
- KV cache warm-up: expectation of slightly higher token cost first 24–48 hours as caches warm.

I’ll attach the full VPC onboarding checklist to the Drive link and we’ll walk it in the call. Karthik — note that if they want canary routing to their legacy cluster we can configure split traffic for the pilot.

See you Tue 10am.
Camila

Perfect — thanks all. Short operational notes so procurement has clarity for the SOW:
- Pilot duration: 3 weeks (config + 2-week observation), deliverables include: performance report (latency / p99), cost estimate at scale, and a runbook for rollback to legacy cluster.
- Rollout options: Private VPC -> Dedicated pool if they want Redwood-managed capacity later. We’ll include clear cutover steps and a canary traffic plan.
- Pricing: Pilot credit applied; if they convert to Dedicated within 30 days we’ll pro-rate credit toward contract.

Jonas — I’ll draft the SOW + simple decision matrix and push to the Drive folder after the call. Rishi — please standby for a short onboarding of CS tasks if pilot goes live.
